assets.name: world-a
assets.prompt: Create a PRODUCTION GAME BACKGROUND TEXTURE ATLAS for a widescreen strategy game about an unseen eldritch presence looking across civilizations. Landscape 3:2 aspect ratio. Four independent edge-to-edge scenes, exact equal 2×2 quadrants split at 50% width and 50% height, HARD straight boundary with NO gutters, no line, no margin. Every scene should fill its quarter, no UI, no words, no border, no montage inside any quadrant, no figures. Top left: HIGH OBLIQUE overview of a rugged wet coastal civilian settlement, a bent crescent shoreline holding slate roofed homes, long working pier, beacon tower, white sea foam against black cliffs, moss and small amber lights; recognizable silhouette separated from dark teal deep sea. Top right: HIGH OBLIQUE deep space view of a civilization's industrial trade habitats, offset chain of long terracotta/copper hollow ring segments and slim tethered orbital platforms, dark violet-black sea of space and scattered lights, all details tightly grouped into a clearly angular silhouette. Bottom left: astronomical view of vast pale luminous branching cosmic infrastructure, luminous thin ivory threads supporting faint filigreed arches in an indigo black cavity, recognizable branching shape and much negative space. Bottom right: eye-level cinematic environment from rocky foreground tidal shore looking out toward stormy sea and a small distressed wooden vessel trapped at black outer reef on center-left, pale foam and drizzle; distant coastal lighthouse on upper right promontory, broad open dim textured beach at lower right where a character can be composited, early dusk, not an altar or formal sacred space. Subtle values, unmistakable material shapes, rich layered environmental detail, restrained light, enough visible dark detail. Painted 2D game environments, fine brush-rendered matte paintings in the tradition of classic atmospheric game background plates. Graphic dark masses of color separated by cold shore fog, mineral materials, restrained amber lamps, spatial depth with foreground and middle-ground readable, painted surfaces not photographic, dark nautical weird fiction.

assets.name: people-a
assets.prompt: Create a game character PARTS sprite atlas, EXACT 2×2 equal quadrants, centered on transparent RGBA background. No UI, text, frames, added decor, floor, drop shadows or brush beyond silhouettes. Each quadrant has one independent isolated part with generous padding so all four parts can be individually extracted. Top left part: head only of weatherbeaten adult woman with short dark curly hair tied back with a visible small braid, looking three-quarters to the left, complete head with only small neck stump. Top right: head only of wiry elderly man with long gray hair and close beard, looking three-quarters left, complete head with neck stump. Both heads very same scale and neck centered at same x position. Bottom left: NECK-DOWN ONLY torso through hips of adult, no head of any kind, narrow shoulders, warm umber oilskin high folded collar and layered maritime shawl, leaning slightly forward, hands grip a simple loose end of wet rope. Bottom right: NECK-DOWN ONLY torso through hips of adult, no head, broad draped navy coat with pale diagonally wrapped scarf and visible gloved hand cradling a broken simple bronze spindle, upright posture. Torso collar opening high and centered. Same three-quarter viewpoint in all parts, all characters dressed as ordinary coast workers in a timeless maritime civilization, separate head and torso intended to align at the neck. Strong silhouette. Blue-gray sky light from upper left, faint warm local light from low right. Canvas square 1024x1024. Painterly digital game portraits with deliberately sculpted readable shapes and subtle woven fabric texture, dusky natural colors, refined illustrated cutout sprites. Keep accurate transparent alpha.
